name: camofox-browser
description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
one_liner: A web browser an AI can control that's disguised to look like a real human is browsing, so it doesn't get blocked by the anti-bot protection most websites use.
buyer: A data/growth engineer at a company that needs to scrape or automate interactions with websites (price monitoring, lead sourcing, form filling) that actively try to block bots.
business_use_cases: A price-intelligence company monitors competitor pricing pages that use Cloudflare bot protection, keeping the feed reliable instead of getting blocked daily.
A lead-generation agency automates data collection from directory sites that block standard scraping tools.
An AI personal-assistant startup uses it so their agent can complete real tasks on the open web (bookings, form submissions) on sites that would otherwise detect and block automation.

money_ideas.idea: Offer it as a managed scraping API — customers send a URL and task, you run it through this stealth browser and return structured data, charging per request.

steal_this: Honest caveat first: bypassing bot detection routinely violates target sites' Terms of Service and can create real legal/ethical exposure — treat this as infrastructure to use carefully, not a guaranteed business. If you do, a weekend project is a narrow scraper-as-a-service for one specific, permission-friendly use case (e.g. monitoring your own client's public listing pages) rather than general-purpose stealth scraping.
